content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> P2 alert fired for Rialto-prod dedicated cluster (reserved-pool: rp-49). Symptoms: elevated 5xx (mainly 503), tail latency spikes, increased kv-cache evictions. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENTS/PD-12345

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-12345 created and routed to eng-oncall. Escalation policy: standard-dedicated. Notifying: @micaela (primary), @mike (secondary).

micaela: acked. I’m taking this. pulling logs from rp-49 now.

mike: I see autoscaler activity around 1738804200 — a scale down then quick scale up. Could be flapping. Grafana: https://grafana.example/d/abc/rp-49

anjali: copying relevant runtime logs:
```
2024-11-09T13:05:02Z [runtime] WARN kvcache: evicting 1024 entries (usage 98%)
2024-11-09T13:05:06Z [http] ERROR write response: context canceled (upstream write failed) -> 503
2024-11-09T13:05:07Z [scheduler] route: rp-49-subpool-2 -> throttled
```

jordan: routing service shows a misroute window: some tenant tokens were sent to rp-49-subpool-2 which only had 2 GPUs and was at 98% util. The request router recently refreshed route table at 13:02 due to autoscaler event.

sara: customer impact from Rialto SRE: failed request rate ~12% last 5m, affects their search endpoints. They reported increased retries. They want ETA.

micaela: short-term mitigation plan: 1) pause autoscaler for rp-49 to prevent churn 2) open immediate soft-fallback route to dedicated-fallback pool (ded-fb-1) 3) warm kvcache where possible. Executing step 1 now.

mike: running pause:```
# api call to control plane
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.example/api/v1/reservedPools/rp-49/autoscaler/pause" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

ops-bot: Autoscaler pause accepted for rp-49 (actor: micaela). Current autoscale state: paused.

jordan: pushing fallback route change:```
PATCH /routing/v1/policies/rp-49
payload: {"fallback": "dedicated-fallback", "immediate": true}
```

ops-bot: Routing change applied. Traffic rerouting started (sampling=10%).

anjali: KV cache miss ratio jumped from 4% -> 42% at 13:05, eviction rate peaked. Likely cause: a recent model rollout increased sequence lengths for some workloads and caused big KV entries that don't fit.

micaela: can we temporarily lower model max_seq or fallback those requests to a hosted variant until pool stabilizes? @anjali @jordan

anjali: yes we can enable hosted fallback for request class 'search' — enabling now.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by micaela (oncall).

mike: I’ve triggered add-capacity for rp-49: +2 nodes (estimate provisioning ~3m). Command: `infractl scale reserved rp-49 +2 --reason \"oncall emergency\"`

ops-bot: Capacity change request accepted. Provisioning started. New nodes expected ~3m.

sara: informing Rialto SRE: "We see higher 503s, autoscaler paused, fallback to hosted enabled, capacity is being added. Expect decreasing error rates in ~3-6 minutes."

micaela: watchlist: tail-latency p95, p99; 5xx rate; kv-cache eviction rate; routing error counts.

(about 6 minutes later)

anjali: metrics update: 5xx rate down from 12% -> 3.1% over last 2m. kv-cache evictions trending down. kvcache hit ratio recovering.

jordan: routing logs show most traffic moved to dedicated-fallback pool and new rp-49 nodes are starting to accept load. rp-49-subpool-2 utilization down to 62%.

mike: infra reports nodes came up successfully and joined pool. scaling event completed.

micaela: good sign. keeping autoscaler paused for now. I'll handoff to morning oncall for postmortem and runbook updates.

sara: Rialto confirmed improved behavior on their side. Thanks team :thumbsup:

micaela: summary / action items: 1) follow-up postmortem (owner: mike) 2) add guardrail to prevent autoscaler rapid flip (owner: jordan) 3) add kvcache eviction alert to pre-emptive paging (owner: anjali) 4) review model rollout that increased seq length (owner: product/model infra)

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-12345 -> resolved (ack resolved by micaela).

ops-bot: Autoscaler remains paused (manual). Remember to unpause when safe or after follow-up plan.

micaela: closing thread here. If errors reappear, re-open or ping eng-oncall and escalate to infra.

-- end of thread --
